Gate self-test verifies package integrity before execution, copies Python tests and validator into an isolated temporary tree, runs Python with -B and PYTHONDONTWRITEBYTECODE=1, and proves the original extracted package remains byte-identical afterwards.

Independent validator applies strict release policy to the outer package and nested packages with their own validation contract. Immutable nested legacy archives without a contract remain subject to safe-path, duplicate, symlink, CRC and declared-hash verification; untracked files, intentional syntax fixtures and formatting deviations are reported as warnings.
Python regression fixture proves that a safe rootless legacy nested ZIP is extracted, manifest-validated and classified as legacy-nested without an error-severity single-root failure.
